label: Define attributable retrieval
artifact: Exact source passages, rather than generated answers
title: A matching word is not an answer.
detail: Make original source paragraphs easy to inspect, and keep unsupported questions visible. The project searches fictional training material with no remote service or answer generator.

label: Build a bounded corpus
title: Separate stable identity from display text.
detail: Validate manual and section IDs, preserve revisions and copy source paragraphs exactly. Normalised terms belong to the index; original wording belongs to the reader.

label: Implement shared ranking
artifact: One browser/Node core with global BM25-style statistics
title: Trace the query from words to ranked sections.
detail: Normalise, remove stopwords, deduplicate query terms and score lexical matches. Filters intersect without rebuilding global statistics, and equal scores use deterministic reference ordering.

label: Keep the source reachable
artifact: Exact paragraph + revision + shareable source URL
title: Let the reader verify the passage.
detail: Show matched terms, the stable reference and complete original text. Render labels as text, preserve search state in the URL and use an unambiguous source fragment.

label: Measure misses and false matches
artifact: 26 labelled queries: 1 positive miss, 4 lexical false positives
title: Keep both kinds of failure in the evidence.
detail: All 18 positive queries count in retrieval metrics, including the paraphrase miss. Eight negative or unsupported queries have their own denominator; four return lexical matches.

label: Package reproducibility
artifact: Shared source, query labels, corpus hashes and per-query output
title: Make the measurement repeatable.
detail: The original verification ran evaluation twice and compared identical output. Download the source and full evidence, including the limitations of this small project-authored dataset.
